customer_read.disabled_because: Operator runs Etsy message replies through their own Grok bot. This lane was read-only (it never typed or sent a reply) but it opened message threads in the trusted Etsy session and staged drafts, which is duplicated effort now. Turning it off also returns its share of the etsy_browser_guard pacing budget to the review-reply drain, which the reads were being paced out to protect.
customer_read.resume_hint: Set enabled back to true if the Grok bot stops covering Etsy messages. Nothing else needs changing: order-driven custom-build detection reads paid Etsy orders, not messages, so it is unaffected.

customer_message_reply.disabled_because: The operator's own Grok bot answers Etsy messages. Duck Ops must not stage, type or send a reply to an Etsy message -- not even one the operator asks for by hand -- so two systems never answer the same customer. This is a SEPARATE switch from customer_read above: reads could be turned back on for context without re-enabling replies.
customer_message_reply.resume_hint: Set enabled back to true only if the Grok bot stops covering Etsy messages. `customer preview` and `customer confirm` refuse while this is false; review_reply below is a different lane and is unaffected.
